spec.title: Merge Intervals
spec.summary: Merge overlapping or touching intervals into disjoint ranges.
spec.description: Each input interval includes its two endpoints. Return a collection of disjoint intervals whose union covers exactly the same points as the input. Intervals that overlap or touch at an endpoint belong together.

examples.explanation: The first two intervals share endpoint 4.

approaches.name: Sort and Sweep
approaches.summary: Sort by start point, then extend the latest merged interval whenever ranges touch.
thinkingSteps: Sort intervals by their start points.
Extend it on overlap; otherwise start a new interval.

bullets: Several ranges may cover the same values.
Sorting makes neighboring overlaps easy to combine.

easier.reason: Practice one ordered scan before processing intervals.
